1.0.0.en: Initial release. Local-network control of iSmartGate (PRO / LITE / MINI) and GogoGate2 garage doors. Real-time Open / Closed status, capability tile with Position toggle, automatic temperature and battery monitoring for wireless tilt sensors. Flow triggers for door opened, door closed, and door left open. Flow conditions for is open / is closed. Toggle action card.

1.0.1.en: Visual polish for App Store certification: redesigned app and driver icons in an outline / negative-space style for clearer recognition at small sizes, and added product photos for the hub and door driver images.
